reason: Wrong side of the market: Best Choice Roofing is a residential roofing CONTRACTOR (282 employees, ~$170M revenue, 85+ locations, HQ Goodlettsville TN, founded 2009) — a BUYER of contractor software like JobNimbus, not a vertical-SaaS vendor with an engineering org. All four matched jobs are duplicate 'Sales Opportunity' postings for door-to-door residential roofing sales reps ('Meet homeowners face-to-face'), containing zero engineering, mobile, release, or delivery signal; there is no quotable line redescribing the stalled-delivery pain Bill Bowers fixes. Match appears to be a vertical-keyword false positive (roofing) rather than evidence of the problem.
